text: 3D Financial Website Terms of Use LOAN PRODUCT 3D Financial offers short term, high interest Flex loans. A Flex loan is an open-end credit plan under which 3D Financial offers repeated noncommercial loans that: 1. may be un secured or secured by personal property; 2. may be without limitation or fixed maturities as to the length of term; and 3. are subject to prepayment in part or whole at any time without penalty. Flex loans should be used to address short term financial needs only. Flex loans are governed by the terms of our loan agreement and the applicable laws of the State of Tennessee.
